status: design-only; do not execute during M0
principle: M0 preserves every readable legacy store. Canonicalization happens only after equivalence, with an idempotent adapter and fixtures proving no loss of earned state.

fields: legacy array/object of five physical shoreline finds

identified_semantic_risks.issue: Legacy Passport and canonical Progression can both remain writable/readable, so they may diverge after canonical Progression has been created.
identified_semantic_risks.consequence: Screens can disagree about XP, badges, discoveries or unlocks.
identified_semantic_risks.decision: After M0, Progression becomes sole write authority; Passport becomes compatibility import/projection only.

identified_semantic_risks.issue: Legacy Passport XP and canonical Progression XP use different level economies.
identified_semantic_risks.evidence: Legacy Passport has five thresholds around 0/120/320/650/1000 while progression-v2 defines ten levels beginning 0/40/100/200/.../2000.
identified_semantic_risks.consequence: Copying numeric XP preserves points but can change the user's interpreted level/title and unlocked content.
identified_semantic_risks.decision: Do not silently reinterpret earned status. Migration must preserve earned unlocks separately and record legacy XP provenance.

identified_semantic_risks.issue: Canonical Progression stores current streak but no historical best field; GameState currently reports best = engine.streak when canonical progression exists.
identified_semantic_risks.consequence: A user's historical best streak can be lost from the canonical projection.
identified_semantic_risks.decision: Future canonical schema should explicitly preserve best_streak before Passport retirement.

identified_semantic_risks.issue: migratePassport prefixes every passport.discoveries entry with bike: without inspecting whether the source is already namespaced.
identified_semantic_risks.consequence: Already-prefixed or non-bike legacy discoveries could be transformed incorrectly.
identified_semantic_risks.decision: Before canonicalization, classify real legacy discovery shapes with fixtures and map by prefix/type rather than unconditional bike:.

identified_semantic_risks.issue: Legacy badge IDs are copied directly into canonical badges.
identified_semantic_risks.consequence: Old badge names can collide with or imply different semantics than new achievements.
identified_semantic_risks.decision: Maintain a legacy badge alias map and preserve unknown badges as legacy achievements rather than dropping them.

identified_semantic_risks.issue: Passport pose/visits/profile fields are not Progression concerns.
identified_semantic_risks.consequence: A monolithic migration could incorrectly force unrelated data into progression.
identified_semantic_risks.decision: Route pose to world/session state, profile to Profile authority, visits to return/analytics metadata if retained.

canonicalization_sequence: read every compatible legacy/current store without deleting any
map old five shoreline find IDs to stable collectible IDs
preserve old XP and old unlock/status semantics as provenance
preserve best streak and legacy badges explicitly
read back and compare semantic counts/unlocks
only after multiple releases stop writing Passport
remove compatibility reads only after migration telemetry/fixtures prove no remaining need
acceptance_invariants: No old storage key is deleted as part of first read/migration.
Migration can run twice with identical canonical result.
All five legacy physical finds remain owned if previously found.
Badge count never decreases solely because of migration.
Previously accessible content does not become locked solely because XP thresholds changed.
Cloud backup/restore round-trips both pre- and post-migration fixtures.
Unknown legacy fields are retained in rollback evidence rather than silently discarded.
